meta.title: Fangcheng: DSH's First Virtual Machine!
meta.description:
Dsh-Fangcheng was born from a group of geeks who love tinkering — and have been burned by it more times than we can count. In the era of self-evolving AI, we believe that "how to safely try something new" matters more than "the new thing itself".

If you are one of these three, Fangcheng was built for you:
1. The plugin-building maniac: writing N new plugins a day and changing code hundreds of times. You used to restart DSH after every edit; now you hot-reload inside Fangcheng, and a broken build rolls back instantly.
2. The multi-tasker: one window for data analysis, one for a crawler, one for long-running tests. Fangcheng lets you open as many as you like without crashing — each in its own absolute isolation.
3. The security worrier: unwilling to hand your client to third-party plugins, afraid of deleted files or stolen API keys. Fangcheng's review gates and independent sandboxes keep risky code boxed in.
